system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
An extension may **also** contribute a **system-prompt contribution** — not a
class but a single module whose default export adds terse, durable guidance to
the system prompt
system_prompt_style.note: System prompt assembled from extension contributions; cmd/juggler/core/system_prompt_presets.go also exists in tree.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: A tool the LLM can call (read a file, search, run a command)
env_context_strategy.note: Built-in glob, read_file tools; no evidence of injected repo context.

context_compaction.evidence_quote:
The oldest history is summarized into a compaction-summary item; the most
recent items stay verbatim.
context_compaction.note: Automatic recovery on overflow plus /compact; oversized tool results summarized in place; cmd/juggler/ops/output_cap.go exists.

observation_format.evidence_quote: How a file type is shown to you and extracted for the model
observation_format.note: File viewers include image; tool_result_image tests in providers suggest image tool results.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Select System Prompt to see exactly what the model is told and which tools it can call
tool_call_format.note: Provider tool_choice/tool_use tests (e.g. cmd/juggler/providers/anthropic/tool_use_block_test.go) suggest native tool calling.

tool_count.note: Tool list of @juggler/core not enumerated in evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: every item type in a conversation (`read-file`, `replace-text`, `bash`, …)
edit_primitive.note: write_file built-in listed in extension guide.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: point Juggler at an [MCP server](docs/mcp.md) and its tools arrive as inspectable, approvable items like any other.
tool_schema_source.note: Built-in tools defined in JS extensions with static MANIFEST (hand-written presumed).

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: MCP servers and skills plug into the same model

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: high-level LLM loops such as `plan`, `research`, or your own fever-dream inventions are plugins too.
loop_primitives.note: Default strategy presumed react; plan strategy selectable.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Strategies** — high-level LLM loops such as `plan`, `research`

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
`subthread` — runs the expanded prompt in an isolated sub-thread and lands
the result back in the conversation

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Any point can branch into a sub-thread.
delegation_mechanism.note: Sub-thread spawn reachable (user/command-initiated); default none assumed.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: When the agent pauses for user intervention — to run a command, apply an edit, take the next step

short_term_state.evidence_quote: It's a Yjs document, not a transcript.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: MCP servers and skills plug into the same model

state_persistence.evidence_quote: you can quit or relaunch and it resumes every conversation exactly where you left it

self_verification.evidence_quote: Strategy** | Controls how the agentic loop runs — turns, tools, stopping

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The turn is retried once, and the loop continues.

rollback.evidence_quote: Create sub-threads, drill down, backtrack, compare, and edit.
rollback.note: Conversation backtrack only; no file rollback evidence.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
If **your newest message alone** exceeds the window, recovery cannot help and
you get a concise terminal error

cost_controls.evidence_quote:
`/compact` folds a conversation on demand through the same engine the
automatic recovery uses: a bounded map/reduce pinned to your model, capped at
8 reduction passes and 64 hidden calls with a spend ceiling.
cost_controls.note: Caching inferred from cmd/juggler/providers/anthropic/cache_control_test.go; cheap_model.go suggests routing for aux calls.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: It does all the work: HTTP/WebSocket server, session store, tool execution.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Tool calls, approvals, thread structure, item properties, raw context

tracing.evidence_quote: Session documents are stored and synchronised with Yjs.

replayability.evidence_quote: click the footer's token count to read back what a past turn actually sent.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: `make test` runs the entire test suite without needing API keys.

open_source.evidence_quote: The official Juggler binaries from [juggler.studio](https://juggler.studio) additionally include WAN access modes
open_source.note: AGPL-3.0 core, Apache-2.0 SDK; WAN components not in repo.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: It talks to the usual model zoo.
